$comment: LitCal leaves imported into block ot-weekdays-18-34 (L-067). At the pinned revision LitCal has weekday data for OT weeks 18-34 only for week 34 of Year I; feriale_per_annum_I is empty for weeks 18-33 and feriale_per_annum_II for weeks 18-34. Run: npm exec -w @lectio/lectionary -- tsx src/cli/import-litcal.ts ot-weekdays-18-34. The weekday gospel is shared by Years I and II, so `shared` imports it without a cycle.
